jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure that change notifications by the Agile teams of the UPS product lines consider the serviceability of the products. You will engage with the change managers of the Agile teams and the stakeholders within Service on a daily basis.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team in Quartino. The main stakeholders include change managers from the Agile teams of the UPS product lines in Quartino, service professionals responsible for technical support, documentation, and spare parts, as well as supply chain specialists responsible for spare part creation and stock management.

You will join a newly formed Service Engineering team, where you will have the opportunity to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing new ECN (engineering change notices) for potential impact on Service
  • Maintaining a tracker for ECN potentially affecting Service
  • Run the meetings where Service stakeholders discuss ECN impact and suggest changes to the change leaders
  • Track the updates to the ECN based on Service stakeholder consensus and approve acceptable ECN
  • Track the execution of Service implementation of the ECN (Service News, Spare part (list) updates, information to global technical support)
  • Providing technical support and solving problems in own expertise area via remote or on-site service in any Service category
  • You will support the change managers pro-actively to improve the correctness, completeness, and effectiveness of the Service aspects of the ECN

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering
  • At least 5 years of experience in similar roles, or 10 years of experience in UPS development or service roles
  • Experience with the product lines manufactured in Quartino
  • Experience with change management process and related documentation
  • Experience in the Windchill change management system
  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu steuern, was die Welt beherrscht.

In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sicherzustellen, dass Änderungsbenachrichtigungen der Agile-Teams der UPS-Produktlinien die Funktionsfähigkeit der Produkte berücksichtigen. Sie engagieren sich täglich mit den Change Managern der Agile Teams und den Stakeholdern innerhalb von Service.

Diese Rolle trägt zum Global Service Engineering Team in Quartino bei. Zu den Hauptakteuren gehören Change Manager aus den Agile Teams der UPS Produktlinien in Quartino, Serviceprofis, die für den technischen Support, die Dokumentation und Ersatzteile verantwortlich sind, sowie Supply Chain Spezialisten, die für die Ersatzteilerstellung und das Lagermanagement verantwortlich sind.

>

>

>

>

>

>

>

>

>

>

>

>

>

>> Sie werden einem neu gegründeten Service Engineering-Team beitreten, in dem Sie die Möglichkeit haben, erfolgreich zu sein.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Analyse neuer ECN (Engineering Change Notices) auf mögliche Auswirkungen auf Service
  • Erhaltung eines Trackers für ECN, der sich möglicherweise auf Service
  • auswirkt Führen Sie Besprechungen durch, in denen die Service-Stakeholder die Auswirkungen von ECN diskutieren und Änderungen an den Change Leadern vorschlagen
  • Verfolgen Sie die Aktualisierungen des ECN basierend auf dem Konsens der Service-Stakeholder und genehmigen Sie das akzeptable ECN
  • Verfolgen Sie die Ausführung der Serviceimplementierung des ECN (Service News, Ersatzteil (Liste) Updates, Informationen zum globalen technischen Support)
  • Bereitstellung von technischem Support und Lösung von Problemen im eigenen Fachgebiet über Remote- oder On-Site-Service in jeder Service-Kategorie
  • Sie unterstützen die Change Manager proaktiv bei der Verbesserung der Richtigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Effektivität der Serviceaspekte des ECN

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Ein Bachelor-Abschluss, Diplom oder eine höhere akademische Qualifikation in Elektrotechnik
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in ähnlichen Rollen oder 10 Jahre Erfahrung in UPS-Entwicklungs- oder Servicerollen
    • Erfahrung mit den in Quartino hergestellten Produktlinien
  • Erfahrung mit dem Change Management Prozess und der zugehörigen Dokumentation
    • Erfahrung im Windchill Change Management System
  • Kenntnisse in mündlicher und schriftlicher englischer Kommunikation (B2-Niveau oder höher) Kenntnisse in einer anderen Sprache sind ein willkommenes Asset

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

Ingénieur principal du soutien technique

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité de s'assurer que les notifications de changement par les équipes Agile des gammes de produits UPS tiennent compte de la fonctionnalité des produits. Vous collaborerez quotidiennement avec les gestionnaires du changement des équipes Agiles et les intervenants du Service.

Ce rôle contribue à l'équipe Global Service Engineering de Quartino. Les principaux intervenants sont les gestionnaires du changement des équipes Agile des gammes de produits UPS en Quartino, les professionnels du service responsables du soutien technique, de la documentation et des pièces de rechange, ainsi que les spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement responsables de la création de pièces de rechange et de la gestion des stocks.

Vous vous joindrez à une nouvelle équipe du génie des services, où vous aurez la possibilité de prospérer.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Analyser le nouveau RCE (avis de changement d'ingénierie) pour déterminer les répercussions possibles sur le service
  • Maintien d'un suivi du RCE pouvant affecter le service
  • Organiser les réunions où les intervenants du Service discutent de l'impact du REC et proposent des changements aux leaders du changement
  • Suivre les mises à jour du REC en fonction du consensus des intervenants du Service et approuver le REC acceptable
  • Suivre l'exécution de la mise en oeuvre du service du CNE (Nouvelles sur le service, mise à jour de la partie de rechange (liste), information à l'appui technique mondial)
  • Fournir un soutien technique et résoudre des problèmes dans son domaine d'expertise par le biais d'un service à distance ou sur place dans toute catégorie de services
  • Vous appuierez les gestionnaires du changement de façon proactive afin d'améliorer l'exactitude, l'exhaustivité et l'efficacité des aspects du service du RCE

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Un baccalauréat, un diplôme ou une qualification universitaire supérieure en génie électrique ou électronique
  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans des rôles semblables, ou 10 ans d'expérience dans le développement d'UPS ou les rôles de service
  • Expérience avec les gammes de produits fabriquées à Quartino
  • Expérience avec le processus de gestion du changement et la documentation connexe
  • Expérience dans le système de gestion du changement de Windchill
  • Compétence en communication orale et écrite en anglais (niveau B2 ou plus) La connaissance de toute autre langue est un atout bienvenu

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: (80 -100%) Service Test Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will support the development of hardware and software tools and procedures to ensure consistent and professional commissioning, diagnostics, and maintenance of Critical Power products (UPS, STS, power conditioning). You will analyze technical documentation and system behavior to provide guidance to software developers. You will test the tools at customer sites and in test environments. You will work with field service technicians to fully understand their workflows and identify opportunities to improve their performance.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team. The main stakeholders are the product R&D teams, service software developers, and field service engineers.

You will join a newly formed, rapidly developing, globally focused team where you will be able to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing technical documentation to support the developers writing programs that support the field service technician’s jobs
  • Testing new programs both in test areas and at customer site to ensure they work as expected
  • Engaging with service technician to train them on the tool and learn from their usage to improve the tool
  • Writing proposals for new Service applications, equipment, and methods

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering
  • Several years of hands-on experience in commissioning, after-sales technical support, and advanced diagnostics of UPS, PCS, or energy storage solutions are beneficial
  • Experience in commissioning and troubleshooting mission-critical applications such as data centers, high-volume industrial facilities, and critical infrastructure installations would be a plus
  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset
  • The ability to write clear and concise technical documents, reports, and field support procedures
  • A willingness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide, with a travel commitment of up to 50%

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Lavorerai con i tecnici del servizio sul campo per comprendere appieno i loro flussi di lavoro e identificare le opportunità per migliorare le loro prestazioni. Questo ruolo contribuisce al team Global Service Engineering. I principali stakeholder sono i team R&D del prodotto, gli sviluppatori di software di servizio e gli ingegneri del servizio sul campo. Ti unirai a un team appena formato, in rapido sviluppo, a livello globale, dove potrai prosperare. Analizzando la documentazione tecnica per supportare gli sviluppatori di programmi di scrittura che supportano i lavori del tecnico del campo Testare nuovi programmi sia nelle aree di prova che sul sito del cliente per assicurarsi di lavorare come previsto Impegnarsi con il tecnico di servizio per addestrarli sullo strumento e imparare dal loro utilizzo per migliorare lo strumento Proposte di scrittura per nuove applicazioni, attrezzature e metodi • Qualifiche per il ruolo:

<
    Diversi anni di esperienza pratica nella messa in servizio, supporto tecnico post-vendita e diagnostica avanzata di UPS, PCS, o soluzioni di stoccaggio di energia sono vantaggiosi Esperienza nella messa in servizio e nella risoluzione dei problemi di applicazioni mission-critical come data center, impianti industriali ad alto volume e installazioni infrastrutturali critiche sarebbero più La conoscenza di qualsiasi altra lingua è un bene di benvenuto La capacità di scrivere documenti tecnici chiari e concisi, report e procedure di supporto sul campo La volontà di impegnarsi direttamente con i clienti e le squadre in tutto il mondo, con un impegno di viaggio fino al 50% di assunzione/li>

Ingénieur principal du soutien technique

Dans ce rôle, vous soutiendrez le développement d'outils et de procédures matérielles et logicielles pour assurer la mise en service, le diagnostic et la maintenance des produits Critical Power (UPS, STS, power conditioning). Vous vous joindrez à une équipe nouvellement formée, qui se développera rapidement et qui sera axée sur l'ensemble du monde, où vous pourrez prospérer.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

jobs.title: Strategy Manager - Motion Business Area
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Head of Strategy and Business Intelligence, Motion

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our strategic growth agenda, we are hiring a new Strategy Manager for our Motion Business Area.

This role is open globally, with preferred locations near our main Motion hubs in Switzerland, Spain, Germany, and Italy. The work model is hybrid #LIhybrid.

The targeted start date for this role is set for November 1st, 2026.

This role aims at strengthening our Motion Business Area’s strategy capability by driving strategic analyses, projects, and narratives that inform senior leadership decision-making. It is designed for a strategy professional who can operate with autonomy, lead strategic workstreams end to end, and translate insights into clear, compelling, and leadership-ready outputs.

The role will collaborate closely with the Motion Leadership Team, Divisions, and key Business Area functions such as M&A, Ventures, Finance, and Sustainability. It will contribute both to core strategy processes and to forward-looking strategic topics, including new growth areas and long-term opportunities.

This role reports to our global Head of Strategy & Business Intelligence, Motion.

Key • Responsibilities

Strategic studies, deep dives & projects

  • Support strategic studies and deep dives, either as standalone projects such as long-term market or technology opportunities, or in close collaboration with Divisions.

  • Structure and deliver strategic projects by defining scope, driving execution with limited supervision, and supporting topics from ideation through analysis to leadership readout and follow-up.

External market & growth opportunity screening

  • Screen external markets, technologies, and competitive dynamics to inform Motion’s strategic priorities, in close collaboration with the Business Intelligence team.

  • Identify and assess new growth opportunities, including Horizon 3 topics, emerging sectors, geographies, and business models.

  • Synthesize external insights into clear implications for Motion’s strategy and portfolio.

Strategic deliverables & leadership narratives

  • Support strategic deliverables for Motion by shaping clear, insight-driven narratives for the Motion Leadership Team, internal stakeholders, and selected external audiences.

  • Translate analyses into concise, strategic, and decision-oriented presentations.

  • Ensure a high standard of storyline, logic, and messaging across all strategy-related outputs.

M&A and portfolio support (strategy perspective)

  • Support M&A and portfolio topics from a strategic perspective, primarily at the Motion Business Area level.

  • Contribute to commercial and strategic assessments for Motion-led deals, including market attractiveness, strategic fit, and value creation logic.

  • Prepare strategy-focused materials for internal reviews and decision forums.

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in relevant fields

  • Several years of experience in strategy, management consulting, corporate development, business intelligence, or a related strategic role

  • Strong strategic thinking & synthesis: Ability to frame problems, structure analyses, and articulate clear strategic implications

  • Independent content creation: Proven ability to build high‑quality presentations and strategic documents with minimal coaching; Excellent PowerPoint and report‑writing skills; able to simplify complex topics into Leadership‑ready material

  • Communication & storytelling: Able to consolidate diverse viewpoints and challenge assumptions constructively

  • Cross‑functional collaboration: Experience working effectively in decentralized organization with multitude of stakeholders to align data, insights, and strategic narratives

  • Proactive mindset & ownership: Demonstrates initiative, curiosity, and a strong sense of accountability; Pushes topics forward and delivers on commitments, even under time pressure

  • Agility & resilience: Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a dynamic, senior‑stakeholder environment

  • M&A exposure: Prior exposure to portfolio topics and strategy‑led deal support is a plus

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to learn more about us and discover the impact of our solutions around the world.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Lead Power Systems Architect
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Program Manager Solid State Transformer

__

Lead Power Systems Architect_Data Center Incubator

We are looking for a Lead Power Systems Architect to join our Direct Current Data Center Incubator, where you will play a pivotal role in accelerating the transition to next‑generation Direct Current data center architectures.

This is a high‑visibility, highly strategic role at the intersection of technology innovation, customer solutions, and industry leadership. You will lead the Direct Current Architecture Workstream, translating customer needs into robust, scalable, and future‑ready technical solutions, while working in close partnership with peers leading LVDC Distribution and Direct Current Source workstreams.

If you are passionate about redefining how data centers are powered, and want to influence standards, roadmaps, and real‑world deployments, this role offers a rare opportunity to make a lasting impact.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Key • Responsibilities

As Lead Power Systems Architect, you will:

  • Own the technical direction of Direct Current architecture solutions for data centers, with a strong focus on safety, efficiency, scalability, and reliability.

  • Design end‑to‑end Direct Current power systems, from concept to pilot and deployment, combining current product portfolios with future technologies.

  • Design advanced control strategies,

  • Define testing strategies and validation plans, ensuring solutions are robust, compliant, and ready for customer deployment.

  • Serve as a technical authority and thought leader, contributing to standards bodies and industry working groups shaping the future of Direct Current data centers.

  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with engineering, product management, and system teams to identify technology gaps and influence product and platform roadmaps.

  • Lead customer pilot projects and installations, defining the skills, capabilities, and resources required for successful execution.

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.

  • 5+ years of experience in power system design, consulting, or solution architecture.

  • Strong expertise in data center power systems and/or DC power solutions.

  • Experience in adjacent environments such as industrial DC systems, marine, rail, or utility applications is highly valued.

  • Proven ability to deliver complex, high‑impact technical solutions.

  • Solid technical foundation in electrical power systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection, and control systems.

  • Leadership & Mindset

  • Experience leading (directly or indirectly) multidisciplinary teams in complex technical environments.

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long‑term vision and near‑term execution.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills across cultures and geographies.

  • Comfortable operating in fast‑evolving, innovation‑driven environments.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer Drive Systems (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Division Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Front-End Sales Engineer, it is your exciting task to implement our sales strategy and to distribute our products and solutions to customers in Switzerland. In close cooperation with our internal service, you consult and convince customers of the benefits of our high-performance products. In addition to looking after existing customers, you are also responsible for the acquisition of new clients. You will systematically conclude contracts with business partners and thus contribute to a sustainable increase in our company's market share.


The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid


This role is contributing to the ABB Motors & Drives division in Switzerland.


You will be mainly accountable for

  • Leading project tendering activities by identifying, qualifying, and actively pursuing project opportunities; coordinating internal stakeholders (engineering, product management, and service) to deliver competitive and compliant technical and commercial proposals
  • Influencing engineering companies and key decision-makers early in the project lifecycle to position ABB solutions as the preferred specification, ensuring alignment with customer technical requirements and long-term value propositions
  • Building strong customer relationships by understanding needs and offering tailored ABB solutions, while leading technical and commercial contract negotiations
  • Tracking market trends, identifying new opportunities, and managing sales processes and documentation, including account plans and SFDC reporting

• Qualifications for the role

  • University degree or diploma of higher education (TS/HF) in a technical field
  • In-depth technical knowledge of motors, generators, drives, and services
  • Demonstrated experience in the management of customer accounts and sales strategy with proven ability to develop and maintain customer relationships
  • Market and customer knowledge are a plus
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills
  • Availability for travel throughout Switzerland, but mainly in the German-speaking part
  • Fluent in German and English, other languages are an advantage

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:


  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus
  • Company Car

More about us

ABB Motors and Drives delivers a complete range of motors, generators and drive products for all industries and applications. Our mission is to be an expert in automated industrial systems, to focus on reliability in our partnerships, and to know our customers’ requirements by heart.


The recruitment process is led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will ensure that all purchased materials and services meet ABB standards by qualifying suppliers, monitoring performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve world-class results.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings / Supplier Business Excellence & Development in Schaffhausen, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supplier Qualification & Audits: Qualify and approve new suppliers and conduct regular process, system, and product audits.

  • Quality • Requirements & FAI: Define and communicate quality requirements and lead First Article Inspections and qualification processes.

  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement: Track supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., PPM, OTD) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Non-Conformance Management: Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective actions (8D/CAPA).



• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent professional experience

  • Good knowledge of English and German (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus

  • Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits (ISO 9001, VDA 6.3, IATF 16949 or similar)

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role within the Customer Project Execution Team, you will conduct customer witnessed testing and verification activities for assignments of medium/high testing complexity of systems,
subsystems, or products effectively and cost-efficiently and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards.

The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the ABB Electrification, Smart Power, Critical Power and Customer Projects Execution team in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • End-to-End Testing Accountability: Plan, prepare, and execute customer-witnessed type tests, including full documentation, while ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, and industry standards.

  • Technical Expertise & Support: Provide technical support during installation and testing, perform first-level troubleshooting, and collaborate closely with Project Management and Sales to ensure successful validation and delivery.

  • Leadership & Collaboration: Guide and support test engineers, promote best practices across projects, and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure testing readiness and quality.

  • Process, Risk & Quality Management: Apply and continuously improve standardized processes and tools, conduct risk assessments to ensure safe operations, and proactively identify and report improvement opportunities.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in testing and validation of products within the electromechanical field. Experience with UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) systems is considered a strong advantage.

  • Strong passion for technical excellence, with the ability and willingness to share knowledge and best practices across teams and projects.

  • Native Italian speaker with strong English (B1) communication skills; able to interact confidently and professionally with customers and internal stakeholders in an international environment.

  • Positive, collaborative, and proactive approach, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to contribute to team performance and engagement.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Assurance, Risk & Internal Controls (ARIC) Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Head of Assurance, Risk and Internal Controls (ARIC)

__

ABB's Data & Systems Modernization (DSM) Program is a multi-years, company-wide initiative to modernize and harmonize ABB's data and systems landscape. DSM aims to simplify complexity, improve governance and data quality, and enable a common roadmap for enterprise platforms and ERP evolution, supporting better, faster decision-making and scalable operations across regions, functions, and business areas.

The Program Assurance, Risks and Internal Controls Lead is accountable for defining, governing, and overseeing the assurance, risk, internal controls, across the end-to-end data and systems modernization program. Primary goal for the Program IC lead is to support the maintenance of the same level of assurance within the DSM program. The role ensures that risks are identified within the program as per the milestones of the program and mitigated through internal controls where necessary.

The lead ensures also the program runs by respecting the ABB assurance governance and framework. Additionally, the lead identifies opportunities for further streamlining the IC framework through the SAP S/4HANA implementation.

This role acts as the single point of accountability at program level for assurance, risk, and controls, working in close partnership with internal controls and compliance leads in the business areas, processes and global functions (e.g. Finance, HR, IT) to ensure consistency, transparency, and audit readiness.

Your • Responsibilities

  • Own the program-wide framework for assurance, risk, and internal controls, aligned with ABB policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards, including the ARIC Handbook

  • Lead the IC SMEs team to deliver the future‑state internal control and GRC design for SAP S/4HANA, including manual and automated controls

  • Coordinate and align IT, business area and process internal controls & compliance leads, ensuring consistent implementation of controls, roles, and access governance across ABB

  • Act as the primary interface to Internal Audit, external auditors, and corporate assurance functions, supporting audit readiness, stage‑gate decisions, and timely remediation of findings

  • Report regularly to program governance bodies on risk exposure, control design maturity, authorization readiness, and remediation progress

  • Provide regular reporting and insights to program governance bodies on control maturity, risks, and remediation progress

Your Background

  • 10+ years of experience in assurance, risk management, and internal controls within large, complex, multinational organizations

  • Experience with ERP transformation programs, including SAP S/4HANA

  • Experience working in a Big 4 accounting firm with exposure to SOX and ERP transformation projects preferrable

  • Solid knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGCs), Automated Control environments (ITACs)

  • Demonstrated skill in collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders without formal managerial authority

  • Experience operating at the intersection of Business, IT, and Risk, with a solid governance and transformation mindset

  • Structured, pragmatic approach with the ability to balance compliance requirements and business enablement

  • Highly effective communicator with the credibility and presence to work well with program leadership and business stakeholders

  • Candidates must be eligible to work in Switzerland. Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.

Join us to play a pivotal role in building a future-ready enterprise, where robust controls and smart governance enable sustainable transformation at scale.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme en génie électrique ou d’une formation équivalente (HES, école d’ingénieurs ou formation technique supérieure)

  • Expérience confirmée en environnement technique industriel, idéalement dans la gestion d’offres ou de projets

  • Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de flexibilité et d’une forte orientation client

  • Excellentes compétences en communication en français et en anglais (l’allemand est un atout)

  • Vous êtes passionné(e) par l’analyse et la sélection de stratégies commerciales et de solutions en fonction des besoins clients

  • Bonne maîtrise des calculs de coûts et de la structuration d’offres techniques

  • Vous possédez un esprit d’équipe, de la fiabilité et une grande intégrité professionnelle



    Your role and responsibilities

    In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (division and market) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your expertise by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation.
    The work model for the role is: hybrid.
    This role is contributing to the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

    You will be mainly accountable for

    • Coordinating quote requests and deadlines as well as conducting procurement negotiations with suppliers during the tendering phase

    • Analyzing and evaluating requests, specifications and tenders from technical and commercial perspectives

    • Defining sales strategies and designing product configurations based on customer requirements in collaboration with sales, engineering and project management

    • Creating commercial and technical quote documentation, including detailed description of products and services

    • Qualifications for the role

    • You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field, or a higher professional qualification in engineering (e.g. Höhere Fachschule, Fachhochschule)

    • You are captivated by independent, flexible and customer-oriented working style

    • You are at ease communicating in French and English (German is an advantage)

    • You are passionate about finding the right sales strategies and products based on customer needs

    • Proven experience of cost calculations

    • You are a reliable team player and personality with integrity

​More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations. We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Intern Treasury Technology
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

ABB’s Corporate Treasury department in Zurich is the backbone of the ABB Group’s worldwide financial infrastructure, managing and executing financial transaction for the Group (debt capital markets, cash management etc.), acting as an inhouse-bank within the ABB Group and supporting ABB’s business with various financial services and products (incl. Foreign Currency and Commodity Hedging, Export and Trade Finance solutions, etc.). The department owns and is supported by several key IT systems/solutions, including among others a Treasury Management System, Guarantee Management System as well as centralized Cash Management Solution.

We are looking for a treasury technology intern (80-100%) to join our team. This internship offers a valuable chance for you to acquire professional experience within the Treasury department of a large multinational corporation during a temporary placement lasting from 12 months to a maximum of 18 months.

As part of our collaborative team, you will be contributing your skills across a myriad of technical areas, including:

  • leading requirements gathering on the project demand list

  • building a unified data model to transform raw data from multiple underlying Treasury solutions into clean usable datasets for reporting and analytics

  • supporting the building of a corporate Snowflake instance for Treasury specific data

  • supporting implementation work on ongoing technology implementations

  • providing insight training to Treasury employees on technology topics, such as AI


Additionally, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with the Treasury Global Process Owner and Middle Office Team, as well as each of the Treasury Workstreams (incl. e.g. internal controls, data cleansing and report generation, etc.).

• Qualifications for the role

We are looking for applicants who possess the following qualifications, reflecting their academic and potential for growth:

  • You will soon finish or have finished your bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Technology, preferable with a specialization in data science/analysis, within the next/past 12 months

  • You are interested in discovering more about financial transactions, finance processes and related data consumed and produced by a large multinational in the Treasury space

  • You have experience in data modelling, database design, data analysis, requirements engineering and have worked with systems/solutions to enable this (SQL, ADF, Snowflake)

  • Any experience in working with Power BI, Treasury Management Systems (ION Wallstreet), SAP and other Treasury applications, is a plus.

  • You demonstrate analytical and organizational skills, are a quick and efficient learner, and build strong relationships within teams

  • You are based in Zurich and hold a current valid VISA/work permit for Switzerland or a confirmation for a mandatory internship from your university

  • You are proficient in English and have effective communication skills

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Foreign Currency and Commodity Hedging, Export and Trade Finance solutions, etc.). That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Global Business Line Manager - Traction Products
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

President Traction Division

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our ambitious growth, we are hiring a new Global Business Line Manager, for our Traction Products business line, part of our Motion Traction Division. This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany, Italy, Sweden, France, Poland.

This Position reports to: President Traction Division

As Global Business Line Manager, Traction Products, you will hold end-to-end accountability for a uniquely positioned and strategically critical product portfolio spanning Traction Motors, Energy Storage Systems (ESS), Auxiliary Converters, and DC-DC Converters.

This is a pivotal enterprise leadership role with responsibility for shaping the future of the product business within the division, advancing commercial excellence, and delivering sustainable, profitable growth across global markets.

Reporting directly to the Division President, you will lead a geographically diverse organization and set the strategic direction for the end-to-end Traction Products business line across its four Product Lines: Traction Motors, Energy Storage Solutions (ESS), Auxiliary Converters, and Brightloop.

You will steer the full value chain, from the performance and direction of Product Line-owned factories and embedded capabilities such as R&D, Engineering, and Product Management to commercial execution, while accelerating growth, strengthening customer relevance, and building long-term competitive advantage globally.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Own full P&L accountability for the Global Traction Products business line, driving sustainable growth, profitability, and cash performance.

  • Lead the strategic evolution and scaling of a competitive product portfolio across motors, ESS, DC-DC converters, and auxiliary systems, strengthening value propositions and market positioning across target segments.

  • Set clear accountability across Product Lines for factories, product management, and engineering, while ensuring alignment with business line priorities and enterprise objectives.

  • Define and execute global go-to-market strategies that expand market share, reinforce pricing discipline, and deepen customer intimacy across segments and regions.

  • Establish and drive performance targets that promote a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the organization.

  • Champion high-impact marketing, sales, and customer engagement strategies that elevate market presence and accelerate growth.

  • Strengthen relationships with key customers and OEMs, positioning ABB as the partner of choice for traction and onboard energy solutions.

  • Lead the successful integration of acquired entities into ABB, realizing targeted value creation, synergies, and organizational alignment.

  • Ensure best-in-class operational performance across manufacturing, supply chain, quality, delivery, and HSE, aligned with ABB’s standards and business ambitions.

  • Build and develop high-performing, values-driven teams through coaching, talent development, and robust succession planning.

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Business Administration, or related field.

  • Proven success leading global business lines or holding significant P&L responsibility within industrial, rail, mobility, or comparable sectors.

  • Strong strategic and commercial acumen, with a demonstrated ability to scale complex product portfolios and translate strategy into measurable business results.

  • Experience leading multi-product, technology-driven businesses with a manufacturing footprint and end-to-end operational accountability.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead a Product Line–driven operating model with distributed ownership, embedded capabilities, and strong enterprise alignment.

  • Strong understanding of customer ecosystems across multiple industries, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and shape competitive positioning.

  • Proven leadership of large, cross-regional organizations, with the ability to align diverse teams around a shared vision and performance agenda.

  • Track record of delivering results in fast-paced environments with complex operational structures, balancing speed, rigor, and execution excellence.

  • Experience in M&A and integration, ideally with direct leadership in integration programs and delivery of targeted value creation.

  • High personal integrity and a strong commitment to ABB’s values, ethics, and compliance standards, serving as a role model for principled leadership.

  • Skilled in leading change and transformation, while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and organizational resilience.

  • Adept at stakeholder management, with strong communication and influencing skills at executive, board, and cross-functional leadership levels.

  • Passion for people, customers, quality, and technology, with a leadership mindset grounded in impact and long-term value creation.

  • Ability to develop people and lead with clarity, purpose, and consistency.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

A l'ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus propre, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à gérer ce qui dirige le monde. Cette position relève de : President Traction Division Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre . Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous vous donnerons ce dont vous avez besoin pour que cela arrive. Il n'a pas toujours été facile, la croissance prend du grit. Mais à ABB, vous ne fuirez jamais seul. Courez ce qui dirige le monde. Dans le cadre de notre croissance ambitieuse, nous embauchons un nouveau directeur de secteur d'activité mondial, pour notre secteur d'activité Produits de traction, qui fait partie de notre division Traction de mouvement. Ce rôle est ouvert à l'échelle mondiale, et nos sites préférés sont situés à proximité de nos principaux sites de Traction en Suisse, Allemagne, Italie, Suède, France, Pologne. Ce poste relève de : President Traction Division En tant que gestionnaire de secteur d'activité mondial, Produits de traction, vous serez tenu responsable de bout en bout d'un portefeuille de produits stratégiquement et positionnés, couvrant les moteurs de traction, les systèmes de stockage d'énergie (ESS), les convertisseurs auxiliaires et les convertisseurs DC-DC. Il s'agit d'un rôle central de chef de file de l'entreprise, qui a la responsabilité de façonner l'avenir du secteur des produits au sein de la division, de faire progresser l'excellence commerciale et d'assurer une croissance durable et rentable sur les marchés mondiaux. Relevant directement du président de la Division, vous dirigerez une organisation géographiquement diversifiée et définirez l'orientation stratégique du secteur d'activité Produits de traction de bout en bout dans ses quatre gammes de produits : Moteurs de traction, Solutions de stockage d'énergie (ESS), Convertisseurs auxiliaires et Brightloop . Vous dirigerez la chaîne de valeur complète, de la performance et la direction des usines appartenant à la gamme de produits et des capacités intégrées telles que la R-D, l'ingénierie et la gestion des produits à l'exécution commerciale, tout en accélérant la croissance, en renforçant la pertinence de la clientèle et en construisant un avantage concurrentiel à long terme à l'échelle mondiale. Principales
• Responsabilités - Posséder la pleine responsabilité de P&L pour le secteur d'activité des produits de traction mondiale, ce qui stimule la croissance durable, la rentabilité et le rendement en espèces. - Diriger l'évolution stratégique et l'échelle d'un portefeuille de produits concurrentiels pour les moteurs, les convertisseurs ESS, DC-DC et les systèmes auxiliaires, renforcer les propositions de valeur et le positionnement du marché pour les segments cibles. - Définir et exécuter des stratégies globales d'accès au marché qui élargissent les parts de marché, renforcent la discipline des prix et renforcent l'intimité des clients dans les segments et les régions. - Établir et orienter des objectifs de rendement qui favorisent une culture de qualité, d'amélioration continue et d'excellence opérationnelle dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. - Champion de stratégies de marketing, de ventes et d'engagement des clients à fort impact qui augmentent la présence du marché et accélèrent la croissance. - Renforcer les relations avec les principaux clients et OEM, en plaçant ABB comme partenaire de choix pour les solutions de traction et d'énergie embarquée. - Diriger l'intégration réussie des entités acquises dans ABB, en réalisant la création de valeur ciblée, les synergies et l'alignement organisationnel. - Assurer une performance opérationnelle optimale dans l'ensemble de la fabrication, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la qualité, de la livraison et du HSE, en conformité avec les normes et les ambitions des ABB. - Créer et développer des équipes hautement performantes, axées sur les valeurs, grâce à un encadrement, au développement des talents et à une solide planification de la relève.
• Qualifications - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en ingénierie, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe. - Succès avéré des secteurs d'activité mondiaux ou des secteurs industriels, ferroviaires, de la mobilité ou comparables. - Forte concentration stratégique et commerciale, avec une capacité démontrée d'écheller des portefeuilles de produits complexes et de traduire la stratégie en résultats opérationnels mesurables. - Expérimenter des entreprises de pointe axées sur la technologie et multiproduits ayant une empreinte manufacturière et une responsabilité opérationnelle de bout en bout. - Capacité démontrée de diriger un modèle d'exploitation axé sur la gamme de produits avec une propriété répartie, des capacités intégrées et un alignement solide de l'entreprise. - Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes clients dans plusieurs industries, avec la capacité d'anticiper les changements de marché et de façonner un positionnement concurrentiel. - Un leadership éprouvé de grandes organisations transrégionales, avec la capacité d'aligner diverses équipes autour d'une vision commune et d'un programme de performance. - Track record de résultats dans des environnements rapides avec des structures opérationnelles complexes, vitesse d'équilibrage, rigueur et excellence d'exécution. - Expérience en matière de fusion-acquisition et d'intégration, idéalement avec un leadership direct dans les programmes d'intégration et la réalisation de la création de valeur ciblée. - Oui. Une grande intégrité personnelle et un engagement ferme envers les valeurs, l'éthique et les normes de conformité de l'ABB, servant de modèle de leadership de principe. - Compétence pour diriger le changement et la transformation, tout en favorisant une culture de responsabilité, d'amélioration continue et de résilience organisationnelle. - Adepte de la gestion des intervenants, avec une forte communication et une influence sur les compétences au niveau de la direction, du conseil d'administration et du leadership interfonctionnel. - Passion pour les gens, les clients, la qualité et la technologie, avec un esprit de leadership fondé sur l'impact et la création de valeur à long terme. - Capacité de développer les gens et de diriger avec clarté, objectif et cohérence. #ABBCareers #RunwithABB #Runwhatrestheworld ABB Motion, leader mondial des moteurs et des moteurs, est au cœur de l'accélération d'un avenir plus productif et durable. Nous innovons et repoussons les limites de la technologie pour contribuer à l'efficacité énergétique, à la décarbonisation et aux solutions circulaires pour les clients, les industries et les sociétés. Grâce à nos entraînements, moteurs et services numériques, nous aidons nos clients et partenaires à améliorer leurs performances, leur sécurité et leur fiabilité. jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Channel Sales & Sales Manager Hub Europe

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced sales professional with new business development focus to take up commercial and operational responsibility for the assigned countries in Europe. In this role, you will drive sustainable growth by enabling local sales teams with market intelligence, offer/tendering leadership and strong customer engagement, while ensuring disciplined planning, forecasting, and governance on strategic opportunities and long term account development.

The work model for the role is: hybrid ; #LI-Hybrid

The role is contributing to the Motion High Power division in globally.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Sales Strategy & Performance Ownership: Leading regional sales planning end-to-end, setting and executing targets, managing key accounts, and driving growth through structured account development and budget discipline.

  • Offer Leadership & Deal Execution: Overseeing complex pursuit processes, coordinating cross-functional teams, and delivering competitive, high-quality proposals to maximize win rates.

  • Forecasting, Pipeline & Profitability Management: Ensuring accurate forecasting and strong pipeline health, driving corrective actions, and optimizing pricing, margins, and sales mix for sustainable performance.

  • Customer Engagement & Market Insight: Engaging customers through technical discussions and negotiations, while leveraging market and competitor intelligence to shape strategy and strengthen positioning.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience in Sales & Marketing or other relevant fields.

  • Knowledge of large electric drives and motors technology and applications.

  • International experience in dealing with global companies with decision makers located in different regions and matrix organizations.

  • BS/MS Degree in Engineering, Business, or Marketing.

  • Strong strategic sales & commercial acumen (pricing, margins, deal structuring), with a focus on new business development.

  • Proven tender/pursuit leadership for complex, high-value solution deals.

  • Advanced stakeholder management & influencing skills in a matrix organization.

  • Excellent data-driven pipeline & forecasting discipline (e.g., SFDC).

  • Ability in customer value selling & high-level negotiations (technical + commercial).

  • Solid influencing skills, flexibility and well accustomed to long sales cycles.

  • Fluent English language skills.

More about us

ABB High Power is a global supplier of high-performance drives, drive systems and packages for industrial processes and large infrastructure applications. With our advanced technology and global support, we help our customers, partners and equipment manufacturers with asset reliability, performance improvement and energy efficiency in mission critical applications. Our people and culture are the foundation of our growth. We all together make the difference for our customers every day.

We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Own the lab infrastructure (Laborinfrastruktur), including coordination with maintenance (Instandhaltung), organizing calibration (Kalibrierung) of equipment, and managing lab supplies (Verbrauchsmaterialien).
  • Ensure lab safety (Sicherheit) and organize/structure lab spaces for multiple ongoing projects.
  • Support scientific work by designing and building power electronics prototypes (Leistungselektronik Prototypen) up to medium voltage (Mittelspannung) and megawatt power.
  • Assist in commissioning test setups (Inbetriebnahme von Prüfaufbauten) and perform testing together with scientific staff (Wissenschaftler).
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders (Teamfähigkeit), and supervise apprentices (Lernende / Auszubildende) in daily tasks.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician (Automatiker EFZ) with practical experience in machining (Fräsen, Bohren, Drehen, Handarbeit), and be able to conversate in English.
  • Additional education from a Higher Technical School or University of Applied Sciences (Höhere Fachschule HF / Fachhochschule FH) in power electronics, energy systems, or similar is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with CAD design (CAD-Konstruktion) using tools such as Creo, Solid Edge, SolidWorks, or equivalent; PCB design (Leiterplattendesign) knowledge is a plus (Altium Designer).
  • Solid experience in electrical circuit design (Schaltungsdesign), grounding concepts (Erdung), and wiring standards (Verdrahtungsrichtlinien).
  • Hands-on experience building and prototyping power electronic systems (Leistungselektronik Systeme), including mechanical work, tooling (Werkzeuge), and implementing ad-hoc improvements.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical standards (e.g., NIV / NIN / SNR 464022) and familiarity with lab technologies such as 3D printing (3D-Druck), LabVIEW, and laser cutting/engraving (Laserschneider / Lasergravur).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

  • Aider à la mise en service des installations d'essai (Inbetriebnahme von Prüfaufbauten) et effectuer des essais avec le personnel scientifique (Wissenschaftler).
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants internes et externes (Teamfähigkeit) et superviser les apprentis (Lernede / Auszubildende) dans les tâches quotidiennes.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Achevé l'apprentissage en tant que technicien d'automatisation (Automatiker EFZ) avec une expérience pratique en usinage (Fräsen, Bohren, Drehen, Handarbeit) et être en mesure de converser en anglais.
  • L'enseignement complémentaire d'une école technique supérieure ou d'une université des sciences appliquées (Höhere Fachschule HF / Fachhochschule FH) dans l'électronique de puissance, les systèmes d'énergie, ou similaire est un avantage important.
  • Expérience avec la conception de CAO (CAD-Konstruktion) à l'aide d'outils tels que Creo, Solid Edge, SolidWorks, ou l'équivalent; la conception de PCB (Leiterplattendesign) est un plus (Altium Designer).
  • Expérience solide dans la conception de circuits électriques (Schaltungsdesign), les concepts de mise à la terre (Erdung) et les normes de câblage (Verdrahtungsrichtlinien).
  • Expérience pratique de construction et de prototypage de systèmes électroniques de puissance (Leistungselektronik Systeme), y compris les travaux mécaniques, l'outillage (Werkzeuge) et la mise en oeuvre d'améliorations ad hoc.
  • Connaissance de base des normes électriques (p. ex. NIV / NIN / SNR 464022) et connaissance des technologies de laboratoire telles que l'impression 3D (3D-Druck), LabVIEW et la découpe laser/gravure (Laserschneider / Lasergravur).

Au centre de recherche ABB de Baden-Dättwil à proximité de Zurich, nous travaillons sur des technologies passionnantes qui façonnent l'avenir de nos produits. Nos équipes de recherche internationales se concentrent sur l'électronique électrique, le stockage de l'énergie, les systèmes intelligents et le commutateur.

jobs.title: Group Government Relations & Public Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Govt Relations & Public Affairs Mgr.

__

Your role and responsibilities:

As part of ABB’s Group Government Relations & Public Affairs (GRPA) team, you will support the development and execution of ABB’s global GRPA strategy. You will contribute to high-level advocacy with policymakers, advance strategic partnerships with external stakeholders, and support senior leadership visibility on key public policy platforms. The role reports to the Director of Policy and Partnerships and is based in Zurich.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

  • Stakeholder engagement, partnerships and advocacy: Support engagement on priority policy topics with governments, international organizations, trade associations, and industry platforms. Contribute to stakeholder mapping, prepare briefings and messaging, organize meetings and events, and manage follow-up actions. Support the strategic direction and day-to-day management of public affairs partnerships, and represent ABB’s policy positions in external fora and internal cross-functional teams.

  • Senior leadership support: Contribute to delivery of high-quality materials for leadership engagements, including briefings, talking points, scripts, and presentations, in close collaboration with relevant teams.

  • Messaging and narratives: Contribute to the development of messaging aligned with ABB’s policy priorities, ensuring consistency with and support of business strategy.

  • Policy monitoring and strategic insights: Monitor policy trends, industry developments, and geopolitical changes to inform engagement strategies. Identify risks and opportunities (e.g., energy transition, industrial policy, digitalization, AI) and translate complex developments into clear, actionable insights and internal briefings.

  • GRPA operations and collaboration: Support annual strategic planning, enhance workflows and knowledge management, and drive the adoption of digital and AI tools to improve team performance. Contribute to global GRPA communities of practice and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Master’s degree (completed or near completed) in International Affairs, Political Science, Public Policy, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Between 2 and 5 years of experience in government relations, public affairs, consulting, public sector, or international organizations, with a keen interest in geopolitics, public policy and business–government relations.

  • Understanding of key policy areas relevant to ABB, such as energy, digitalization, and industrial policy, is an advantage.

  • Well-developed research and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to translate complex topics into clear, concise materials for senior audiences.

  • Solid organizational skills, ability to manage multiple priorities, and strong interpersonal skills to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.

  • High level of ownership, with a curious, solution-oriented, and engaged approach, interest in digital

  • Solid written and presentation skills in English are essential.

More about us:

We are ABB’s Group Government Relations & Public Affairs team, representing ABB globally by engaging policymakers, building strategic partnerships, and shaping policy conversations to support the company’s leadership in electrification, sustainability, automation, and innovation.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Internship in Computer Vision for Marine and Ports (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Senior Engineer

__

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products. We would like to give a motivated student an opportunity to complete a six-month internship with a multidisciplinary team at the Sensing and Analytics group of ABB.

At ABB, we envisioned future marine and port operations that are safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. To realize this future, we are developing advanced technological solutions that are based on various sensing modalities.

During this internship, you will have an opportunity to work on different aspects of a system for marine and port automation. The focus is on machine learning algorithms. You will work with synthetic and real-world data from various sensors (e.g., camera or LiDAR).

Your role and responsibilities

  • Exploration of current challenges in Marine or Ports via direct interaction with ABB R&D units

  • Review of academic literature

  • Design, evaluation and documentation of potential solutions

  • Quick prototyping of solutions through proof-of-concept implementations

• Qualifications for the role

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or similar field; enrollment to 5th semester or higher is essential

  • Interest in at least one of the following fields: data analytics, machine learning, computer vision

  • Experience with Python and PyTorch is required. Experience with ROS2 and/or LiDAR is a plus

  • Proficiency in English

  • Willingness to learn and quickly adapt to new research topics

  • Self-motivation and hands-on attitude

  • Ability to think conceptually and express ideas clearly and convincingly

  • Availability for six months (start and end dates are open for discussion)

Application Details:

Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that a certificate from your university, showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies, is required for the visa application.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Procurement Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your skills by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to Procurement team in Schaffhausen, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Electrification Division.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Manage sub projects in sourcing and benchmarking activities
  • Support the local Power User with our eProcurement tools
  • Assist and support in process optimization
  • Report on price development and market intelligence
  • Master Data correction actions & document management
  • External supplier correspondence and KPI tracking and reporting
  • Organize and prepare supplier visits and audits

• Qualifications for the role

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor or Master degree in economics, engineering, information systems or similar with first supply chain experience
  • Fluent in German and English
  • Confidential handling of MS Excel
  • Good communication skills; shows initiative, self-managing, and well-organized working behavior
  • Curiosity and initiative
  • SAP knowledge is a plus
  • You hold a current valid VISA/work permit for Switzerland or a confirmation for a mandatory internship from your university

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.
