jobs.title: Field Service Technician (Midlands / Bern Region) (80–100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Service Team Leader


Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this position, you will have the opportunity to perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and in compliance with ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure high‑quality customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and carrying them out according to customer orders and expectations. With your clear communication skills, you help maintain customer satisfaction and loyalty by clearly conveying schedules and expectations.

Work model: Onsite

This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Key stakeholders include customers, field‑service colleagues, and the internal service coordinator team.

Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Collaborating with customers on‑site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges

  • Performing field‑service tasks, identifying technical issues, and conducting on‑site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified

  • Preparing material lists for service assignments and ensuring that all required materials, parts, and equipment are available and in proper condition

  • Providing training to field‑service colleagues and customers when required

Our Team

You will join a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician, electrician, electrical installer, or a comparable technical qualification

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage

  • Extensive knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and field‑service methods in an industrial environment

  • High customer orientation, flexibility in handling changing requirements, and a constructive approach to problem‑solving within the team

  • Fluent German and basic English skills; professional communication in customer interactions

  • Willingness to travel, participate in on‑call duty, and occasionally work on weekends; main service area: Mittelland / Bern region

  • Valid driver’s license for assignments within Switzerland

Benefits

• We offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th‑month salary, and employee share acquisition program (ESAP)

  • Development opportunities through targeted training and career advancement

  • Company vehicle and fleet discounts

  • Contribution toward your gym membership and medical services (IFA)

  • REKA checks and Swibeco discounts

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to assist the Quality team in implementing and maintaining a quality system, including conducting audits, establishing controls, training on tools and methodologies. Each day, you will support activities related to quality management within the organizational unit. You will also showcase your skills by reporting quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and customer cases and maintaining process documentation.

Prevention and surveillance have a key role in manufacturing to ensure optimal quality level and keeping cost under control. As production quality technician, you will represent the voice of customer into the shopfloors, ensuring that the control plan and quality procedures are in place and adhered to. You will also monitor CTQ and quality indicator of OEE to take preventive action on quality problems and supervising the release of production batches in accordance with quality prescriptions.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Performing series release tests of manufactured components or products and monitoring the results.
  • Participating in shopfloor meetings within production.
  • Resolving internal claims in cooperation with other departments.
  • Conducting first‑line internal non‑conformity analysis and initiating the problem‑solving process in case of escalation.
  • Managing Q‑data including deployment of quality control procedures in Q‑software and adjustment of process parameters.
  • Controlling and reporting production‑related Q‑KPIs such as internal failure costs, CTQs, and FPY.
  • Providing quality training to production staff, supervising test equipment, and carrying out process audits and confirmations.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Test equipment verification including calibration.
  • Technical background in electrical and/or mechanical fields.
  • Experience performing release tests for serial production.
  • Understanding of Q‑KPIs and control charts.
  • Knowledge of process audits and related quality methods.
  • Good language skills in German and English, written and spoken.
  • Goal‑oriented, problem‑solving mindset with L6S knowledge (yellow/green belt preferred), collaborative approach, initiative, teamwork ability, and responsiveness.

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Täglich unterstützen Sie Aktivitäten rund um das Qualitätsmanagement innerhalb der Organisationseinheit. Darüber hinaus stellen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten unter Beweis, indem Sie hochwertige Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) und Kundenfälle melden und die Prozessdokumentation pflegen. Prävention und Überwachung spielen in der Fertigung eine Schlüsselrolle, um ein optimales Qualitätsniveau sicherzustellen und die Kosten unter Kontrolle zu halten. Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #LI-onsite Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für: - Durchführen von Serienfreigabetests hergestellter Komponenten oder Produkte und Überwachen der Ergebnisse. - Teilnahme an Shopfloor-Meetings innerhalb der Produktion. - Bearbeitung interner Schadensfälle in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen. - Durchführung einer ersten internen Nichtkonformitätsanalyse und Einleitung des Problemlösungsprozesses im Eskalationsfall. - Verwaltung von Q-Daten, einschließlich der Bereitstellung von Qualitätskontrollverfahren in Q-Software und Anpassung von Prozessparametern. - Kontrolle und Berichterstattung produktionsbezogener Q-KPIs wie interne Fehlerkosten, CTQs und FPY. - Bereitstellung von Qualitätsschulungen für Produktionsmitarbeiter, Überwachung von Testgeräten und Durchführung von Prozessaudits und -bestätigungen.
• Qualifikationen für die Rolle: - Überprüfung der Testausrüstung einschließlich Kalibrierung. - Technischer Hintergrund im elektrischen und/oder mechanischen Bereich. - Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Freigabetests für die Serienproduktion. - Verständnis von Q-KPIs und Kontrolldiagrammen. - Kenntnisse über Prozessaudits und damit verbundene Qualitätsmethoden. - Gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift. - Zielorientierte, problemlösende Denkweise mit L6S-Kenntnissen (gelber/grüner Gürtel bevorzugt), kollaborativem Ansatz, Initiative, Teamfähigkeit und Reaktionsfähigkeit. jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Manager

__


Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop an effective division sales strategy within a regional market scope (Europe) and maintain it, to improve ABB’s market penetration and realize growth aspirations. Each day, you will define, plan, lead, and ensure the execution of sales strategy to achieve both qualitative and quantitative sales targets for products, systems, and/or services to ensure sustainable order growth, revenue, profitability, market share, sales productivity, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by leading, developing, and coaching the Sales organization (other sales managers and sales specialists within scope) to achieve the sales targets through high performance.

The work model for the role is: hybrid (#LI-hybrid)

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Defining sales targets, establishing performance metrics, and monitoring performance to ensure target achievement

  • Identifying and developing opportunities with existing and potential customers, including resource planning and execution

  • Supporting pricing decisions and ensuring alignment with market levels in collaboration with Product Management

  • Managing risks related to contracts, customers, and financial exposure, while supporting compliance with internal standards and policies

• Qualifications for the role:

  • You have experience in developing and executing sales strategies in a B2B environment involving products, systems, and/or services

  • You demonstrate a strong track record in achieving sales targets and driving business performance

  • You bring experience in leading, coaching, and developing sales teams

  • You are comfortable working with performance metrics and implementing corrective actions where needed

  • You have experience in customer engagement, including opportunity development and participation in contract-related activities

  • You hold a degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or bring equivalent practical experience

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Sales Support Specialist w/m/d (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will support ABB Switzerland’s local sales organization as well as our customers throughout the entire quotation process in the field of drive technology. You will act as the central technical point of contact within your area of responsibility and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders on a daily basis.


• Your responsibilities include optimally sizing products for customers to best meet their requirements and applicable standards. In addition, you will calculate costs and prepare quotations with the relevant technical information. You will apply your technical expertise in a targeted manner and make a significant contribution to the successful preparation of proposals.


Work model: Hybrid


This position supports the local sales unit (Motion) in Baden, Canton Aargau.


Your main responsibilities

  • Technical consulting & solution development: You support sales and customers in selecting technically optimal and economically viable solutions for drive and automation systems.
  • End-to-end quotation management: You prepare and calculate technical and commercial quotations and support them through to successful completion.
  • Analysis & optimization: You analyze customer needs, market and competitor information, as well as lost opportunities, and derive targeted improvement measures.
  • Collaboration & quality assurance: You work closely with sales, business units, and other stakeholders and ensure compliance with quality, compliance, and HSE standards.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed technical education (e.g., automation technician, electronics technician, automation specialist, or similar)
  • Several years of professional experience (min. 5 years) in sales support, sales, or project environments
  • Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken
  • Strong customer orientation and excellent communication skills
  • Analytical mindset and understanding of markets and processes
  • Initiative, structured way of working, and assertiveness
  • Advantageous: French language skills and further education at HF level (e.g., certified technician HF)

Benefits

• We offer, among others:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus

More about us

ABB Motion provides industrial customers with cutting-edge technologies, products, solutions, and related services to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and ensure precise control of processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators, and drives for a wide range of applications across all industries.


The recruitment process is managed by Ece Özen, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Sales Support Manager

  • Analyse & Optimierung: Sie analysieren Kundenbedürfnisse, Markt- und Wettbewerberinformationen sowie verpasste Chancen und leiten daraus gezielte Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab.
  • Zusammenarbeit & Qualitätssicherung: Sie arbeiten eng mit Vertrieb, Geschäftseinheiten und anderen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgen für die Einhaltung der Qualitäts-, Compliance- und HSE-Standards.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z. B. Automatisierungstechniker, Elektroniktechniker, Automatisierungsspezialist oder ähnliches)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mindestens 5 Jahre) in Sales Support, Sales oder Projektumgebungen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen
  • Starke Kundenorientierung und ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeit
    • Analytische Denkweise und Verständnis von Märkten und Prozessen
  • Initiative, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Vorteil: Französische Sprachkenntnisse und Weiterbildung auf HF-Niveau

Benefits

>Vorteilig: Französische Sprachkenntnisse und Weiterbildung auf HF-Niveau (z.B. zertifizierter Techniker HF)

Benefits

• Wir bieten unter anderem an:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
    • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
    • Eco bonus

Mehr über uns

ABB Motion bietet Industriekunden modernste Technologien, Produkte, Lösungen und damit verbundene Dienstleistungen, um die Energieeffizienz zu erhöhen, die Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit zu verbessern und eine präzise Kontrolle der Prozesse zu gewährleisten. Das Portfolio umfasst Motoren, Generatoren und Antriebe für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen in allen Branchen.


Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Ece Özen, Talent Partner, geleitet.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire du soutien aux ventes

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous soutiendrez l'organisation de vente locale ABB Suisse ainsi que nos clients tout au long du processus de soumission dans le domaine de la technologie d'entraînement. Vous agirez comme point de contact technique central dans votre secteur de responsabilité et collaborerez quotidiennement étroitement avec les intervenants internes et externes.


• Vos responsabilités incluent des produits de taille optimale pour les clients afin de répondre au mieux à leurs exigences et aux normes applicables. En outre, vous calculerez les coûts et préparerez les devis avec les informations techniques pertinentes. Vous appliquerez votre expertise technique de façon ciblée et apporterez une contribution importante à la préparation réussie des propositions.


Modèle de travail : hybride


Ce poste appuie l'unité de vente locale (Motion) de Baden, Canton d'Argovie.


Vos principales responsabilités

  • Conseil technique & développement de solutions: Vous aidez les ventes et les clients à choisir des solutions techniquement optimales et économiquement viables pour les systèmes d'entraînement et d'automatisation.
  • Gestion des devis de bout en bout : Vous préparez et calculez les devis techniques et commerciaux et les supportez jusqu'à leur achèvement.
  • Analyse et optimisation : Vous analysez les besoins des clients, les informations sur le marché et les concurrents, ainsi que les possibilités perdues, et vous obtenez des mesures d'amélioration ciblées.
    • Collaboration et assurance de la qualité : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les ventes, les unités opérationnelles et d'autres intervenants et vous assurez la conformité aux normes de qualité, de conformité et d'ESH.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Formation technique complète (p. ex. technicien en automatisation, technicien en électronique, spécialiste de l'automatisation, ou similaire)
  • Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle (min. 5 ans) dans le soutien aux ventes, les ventes ou les environnements de projets
  • Très bonnes compétences en allemand et bonnes compétences en anglais, à la fois écrites et parlées
  • Orientation du client et excellentes compétences en communication
  • Analyse de l'état d'esprit et compréhension des marchés et des processus
  • Mode de travail initial, structuré et d'affirmation de soi
  • Avantage : compétences en français et formation continue au niveau HF (p. ex. technicien certifié HF)

Avantages

• Nous offrons, entre autres :

  • Plan d'acquisition d'actions d'employés (PAES)
  • REKA crédit
  • Réductions d'employés (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Le congé parental
  • Indemnité d'assurance
  • Bonus

En savoir plus sur nous

ABB Motion fournit aux clients industriels des technologies, des produits, des solutions et des services de pointe pour accroître l'efficacité énergétique, améliorer la sécurité et la fiabilité et assurer un contrôle précis des processus. Le portefeuille comprend des moteurs, des générateurs et des lecteurs pour un large éventail d'applications dans toutes les industries.


Le processus de recrutement est géré par Ece Özen, Talent Partner.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact ?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

jobs.title: Internship in Sustainable Polymer Materials (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Materials

__

Your role and responsibilities:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Materials team at the ABB corporate research center in Switzerland. In the frame of a six-month internship scheduled to start in August or September 2026, you will be able to put theory into practice by contributing to our projects related to future energy technologies.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to current technology development projects focusing on sustainable thermoplastic and thermoset polymers
  • Optimize processing and curing conditions of the materials at laboratory scale
  • Characterize thermal, mechanical and electrical properties, and investigate surface wettability and accelerated aging performance of sustainable polymer materials
  • Perform polymer recycling experiments to enable a circular polymer economy
  • Analyze and document experimental data, present results to the project team, and contribute to technical discussions

You will join a highly motivated and multidisciplinary team that is passionate about materials, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor`s or Master`s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science/Engineering, or a related discipline (completion of at least six semesters); official enrollment is essential
  • General understanding of and interest in polymer materials
  • Fundamental knowledge in polymers is of advantage
  • Experience in laboratory work and know-how in experimental methods
  • Motivated, self-motivated mindset and ability to work independently
  • Highly conscientious individual with a keen sense of responsibility
  • Fluent command of English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

What's in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products.

The Materials team at ABB’s Swiss research center in the proximity of Zurich focuses on the development and manufacturing of innovative materials to be implemented in the company’s future products. We are currently offering outstanding students the chance to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers in the field of metallic, composite and polymer materials.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Im Rahmen eines sechsmonatigen Praktikums, das im August oder September 2026 beginnen soll, können Sie Theorie in die Praxis umsetzen, indem Sie zu unseren Projekten im Zusammenhang mit zukünftigen Energietechnologien beitragen.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Beitragen zu aktuellen Technologieentwicklungsprojekten mit Schwerpunkt auf nachhaltigen thermoplastischen und duroplastischen Polymeren
  • Optimieren Sie die Verarbeitungs- und Aushärtungsbedingungen der Materialien im Labormaßstab
  • Charakterisieren Sie die thermischen, mechanischen und elektrischen Eigenschaften und untersuchen Sie die Oberflächenbenetzbarkeit und die beschleunigte Alterungsleistung nachhaltiger Polymermaterialien
  • Durchführen von Polymerrecyclingexperimenten, um eine zirkuläre Polymerwirtschaft zu ermöglichen
  • Analysieren und dokumentieren Sie experimentelle Daten, präsentieren Sie dem Projektteam Ergebnisse und tragen Sie zu technischen Diskussionen bei

Sie werden einem hochmotivierten und multidisziplinären Team beitreten, das sich für Materialien begeistert, wo Sie gedeihen können.

  • Derzeit verfolgen einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Chemie, Materialwissenschaften / Engineering, oder eine verwandte Disziplin (Abschluss von mindestens sechs Semestern); offizielle Einschreibung ist wichtig
  • Allgemeines Verständnis und Interesse an Polymermaterialien
  • Grundlegende Kenntnisse in Polymeren sind von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung in Laborarbeit und Know-how in experimentellen Methoden
  • Motivierte, selbstmotivierte Denkweise und Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten
  • Hoch gewissenhafte Person mit einem ausgeprägten Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Fluent beherrscht Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen; Deutsch ist ein Plus

Was ist für dich drin

Wir befähigen Sie, Initiative zu ergreifen, Ideen herauszufordern und mit Zuversicht zu führen. Sie werden durch sinnvolle Arbeit, kontinuierliches Lernen und Unterstützung wachsen, die auf Ihre Ziele zugeschnitten ist. Jede Idee, die du teilst und jede Handlung, die du unternimmst, trägt zu etwas Größerem bei.

ABB Corporate Research entwickelt in enger Zusammenarbeit mit seinen verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen die Grundlagen für die nächste Generation von ABB-Produkten.

Das Materialteam im Schweizer Forschungszentrum von ABB in der Nähe von Zürich konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung und Herstellung innovativer Materialien, die in die zukünftigen Produkte des Unternehmens integriert werden sollen. Wir bieten derzeit herausragenden Studierenden die Möglichkeit, sich unserem multidisziplinären Forscherteam auf dem Gebiet der Metall-, Verbundwerkstoff- und Polymerwerkstoffe anzuschließen.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Mara Werne, Talent Partner bei ABB Schweiz, Ltd.

Wenn Sie mehr über ABB erfahren möchten, werfen Sie einen weiteren Blick auf unsere Website www.abb.com.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire d'équipe de recherche - Matériel

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités:
Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité d'acquérir une expérience professionnelle grâce à un stage temporaire. Chaque jour, vous acquerrez des connaissances en accomplissant les tâches comme indiqué. Vous présenterez également votre expertise en soutenant les opérations d'ABB et en améliorant les possibilités d'éducation/d'emploi personnelles.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Onsite

Ce rôle contribue à l'équipe Matériaux du centre de recherche d'ABB en Suisse. Dans le cadre d'un stage de six mois qui débutera en août ou septembre 2026, vous pourrez mettre la théorie en pratique en contribuant à nos projets liés aux technologies énergétiques futures.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Contribuer aux projets de développement technologique actuels axés sur les polymères thermoplastiques et thermorésistants durables
  • Optimiser les conditions de traitement et de traitement des matériaux à l'échelle du laboratoire
  • Caractériser les propriétés thermiques, mécaniques et électriques et étudier l'humidité de surface et la performance vieillissante accélérée des matériaux polymère durables
  • Exercer des expériences de recyclage des polymères pour permettre une économie de polymères circulaire
  • Analyser et documenter les données expérimentales, présenter les résultats à l'équipe du projet et contribuer aux discussions techniques

Vous rejoindrez une équipe très motivée et multidisciplinaire qui est passionnée par le matériel, où vous serez en mesure de prospérer.


• Qualifications pour le rôle:

  • Actuellement, poursuivre un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en chimie, en sciences des matériaux ou en génie, ou une discipline connexe (achèvement d'au moins six semestres); l'inscription officielle est essentielle
  • Compréhension générale et intérêt pour les matériaux polymères
  • Les connaissances fondamentales en polymères sont avantageuses
  • Expérience dans le travail en laboratoire et le savoir-faire en méthodes expérimentales
  • Maîtrise motivée et automotivée et capacité de travailler de façon indépendante
  • Personne hautement consciencieuse ayant un sens aigu des responsabilités
  • Commandation fulgurante de l'anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée; l'allemand est un plus

Ce qu'il y a dedans pour vous

Nous vous donnons les moyens de prendre des initiatives, de contester les idées et de diriger avec confiance. Vous grandirez grâce à un travail significatif, l'apprentissage continu et le soutien qui est adapté à vos objectifs. Chaque idée que vous partagez et chaque action que vous prenez contribue à quelque chose de plus grand. En savoir plus sur nous

ABB Corporate Research, en étroite collaboration avec ses différents secteurs d'activité, développe les bases de la prochaine génération de produits ABB.

L'équipe Matériaux du centre de recherche suisse d'ABBS à proximité de Zurich se concentre sur le développement et la fabrication de matériaux innovants à mettre en œuvre dans les futurs produits de la société. Nous offrons actuellement aux étudiants exceptionnels la possibilité de rejoindre notre équipe multidisciplinaire de chercheurs dans le domaine des matériaux métalliques, composites et polymères.

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Mara Werne, Talent Partner chez ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur ABB, consultez notre site Web www.abb.com

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager - Commercial&Operations

__

Your role and responsibilities

Working in the Energy Industries division, based in eastern Europe, optionally worldwide, you will be cooperating with international teams to maintain the highest levels of customer satisfaction in our worldwide applied solutions for electrical power generation. Reporting to the Head of Product Support, you will perform various product and life cycle activities to assist in the development, launch, maintenance, and profitability of UNITROL, MEGATROL and SYNCHROTACT products.

The work model for the role is: hybrid (ideally within presence of current business locations )

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Technical support for ABB experts worldwide, ABB business partners and End customers with Salesforce as the CRM (Customer relationship management) platform and participation in ensuring 24/7 availability of remote support line
  • Leading resolution teams and handling customer communication for support cases where different stakeholders (e.g., System experts, R&D, Quality etc.) build a resolution team according to severity, complexity, and urgency
  • Leading and support with type test activities, component specifications, life cycle solutions and product engineering etc.
  • Supporting customers with grid code compliance studies (e.g. Power Factory, PSS/E, PSCAD) and digital transformation (e.g. cyber security, digital twin). Training and onboarding support can be offered in this matter.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor or master’s in electrical engineering

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in field service or engineering with Power Generation System know how, Embedded Software and Control Hardware plus Power Electronics (Experience with excitation systems is preferred)

  • Specific experience in grid code compliance studies is preferred

  • Fluency in English, any other languages are an asset

  • Proactive attitude to drive innovation and improvement

  • Proven organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously

  • High sense of responsibility and commitment

  • High degree of intercultural awareness

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Salesforce Solution Architect for Marketing & Sales
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Salesforce Product Owner for Marketing and Sales

__

The Salesforce Solution Architect for Marketing & Sales will play a critical role in shaping ABB’s Salesforce platform, ensuring scalable, secure, and high‑quality solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and long‑term platform strategy. This role partners closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions while minimizing technical debt and maximizing solution reuse.

This is a global role and the working model is: Hybrid / Remote.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • End‑to‑end ownership of Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Marketing Cloud, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards
  • Define and govern scalable, secure, and maintainable architectures, guiding design decisions, technical breakdowns, and implementation of solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to translate requirements into future‑ready technical solutions and architectural roadmaps
  • Design and oversee Salesforce integrations (APIs, events, middleware) in collaboration with integration architects to ensure consistency and performance
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, and governance principles while proactively identifying risks and preventing technical debt
  • Lead architectural governance, design reviews, and technical decision forums while promoting Salesforce best practices and standardization
  • Mentor developers and technical teams, supporting DevOps practices (CI/CD, release management) and driving continuous improvement across the platform
  • Support demand prioritization and solution feasibility discussions, advising stakeholders on architectural trade‑offs and long‑term impacts

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline and 12+ years of IT experience, including 8+ years in Salesforce architecture, technical leadership, or senior development roles
  • Relevant Salesforce certification is highly desirable (Salesforce Certified Administrator / Advanced Administrator / Salesforce Application Architect and/or System Architect / Salesforce Data Architect, Integration Architect, and Identity & Access Management Architect / Salesforce Platform Developer I & II / Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud Consultant / Salesforce Experience Cloud Consultant / Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist / Salesforce JavaScript Developer Certification
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale, enterprise Salesforce implementations within complex, global environments.
  • Deep expertise in Salesforce architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Marketing Cloud / Account Engagement
  • Strong hands‑on technical experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, APIs, integrations, and Salesforce security architecture
  • Solid understanding of integration patterns (REST, events, middleware such as MuleSoft), DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical perspectives
  • Ability to operate effectively in Agile environments and balance short‑term delivery with long‑term platform strategy

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role you will have the opportunity to drive high quality life cycle management of critical power equipment: from developing new products and features to maintaining and improving existing solutions. Each day, you will use your skills and technical expertise to generate mechanical design requirements. You will also showcase your expertise by testing and documenting your designs for coordination with other technical teams within AU Critical Power.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Critical Power Agile Unit in Quartino, Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to the mechanical design deliverables (design and documentation) required for the development of new or enhanced models of critical power equipment.

  • Working with others cross-functionally to deliver designs in a timely manner with high-quality deliverables that meet customer expectations and project requirements.

  • Contributing to design reviews and verification following the established design review process, providing feedback on designs and making modifications

  • Designing and releasing mechanical prototypes, supporting the fabrication of those prototypes, and leading the improvement process following prototype fabrication

  • Leading product design improvement opportunities to reduce product cost

  • Supporting in converting conceptual designs into engineering documentation and in maintaining existing products.

  • Working with all areas of the business (production, supply chain, service, etc.) to ensure products being developed or enhanced meet the needs of the entire business


Our team dynamics:
You will join a diverse and innovative team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • A University Degree in Mechanical Engineering with 2+ years of experience

jobs.title: Customer Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the quality strategy for a local organisational unit, including quality culture, systems, tools, and competent teams with the aim to achieve and exceed customer expectations, while ensuring sustainable operations. Each day, you will assist the organization in achieving the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. You will also showcase your expertise by collaborating with local functions that impact the quality results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world-class performance.

The work model for the role is: #LI- hybrid

This role is contributing to the Power Protection, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing the customer and processes issues systematically to identify root causes and initiate cases in the Practical Problem Solving (PPS) tool to track corrective activities and ensure resolution.

  • Presenting quality reports and improvement initiatives to customers, with systematic follow-up on agreed actions.

  • Defining containment, corrective, and preventive actions. Facilitate Level 2 Quality Circles and escalate critical cases to the line manger when necessary.

  • Contributing to the improvement of key quality metrics including First Pass Yield (FPY) manufacturing, Supplier PPM, Customer DPU, and overall Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).


You will join a dynamic, talented and high-performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in quality or equivalent role

  • Deep understanding of quality processes, problem-solving methodologies, and continuous improvement tools

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with proven ability to engage stakeholders at all organisational levels

  • Flexibility to work beyond standard hours and perform effectively under pressure

  • Fluent in English and Italian (written and spoken)

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification is a plus

  • Willingness to travel up to 10% of the time for customer visits and site inspections​


More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Chapter Leader (Control Firmware)


Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

Work model: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Firmware Development: Design, develop, and implement firmware for Power Electronic Converters and communication modules, ensuring robust functionality and cybersecurity.

  • Software Quality Assurance: Conduct unit, integration, and system testing to validate software performance and reliability.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with system architects and hardware/software engineers to translate system requirements into detailed firmware specifications.

  • Innovation and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to intellectual property creation and collaborate with global engineering teams to drive continuous improvement and share expertise.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • You are highly skilled in C/C++/Python/assembler backed by solid computer science fundamentals.

  • You have solid knowledge in structured development processes, ranging from requirement analysis, design, and implementation to test and documentation.

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in designing control firmware based on microcontrollers / DSPs for Power Electronic Products such as UPS, BESS, Renewable Energy systems.

  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of development infrastructure: Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (git), lifecycle management, build systems, unit testing, debug probes, oscilloscopes, and similar tools.

  • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Ethernet/IP, IEC61850, Profibus, CAN bus) are a plus.

  • You are passionate about team working and innovation.

  • M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree in Information or Electrical, Power Electronic, Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, or comparable field

  • You are at ease communicating in English and Italian

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.
Run What Runs the World.

#ABBCareers #RunwithABB

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a superare - più snella e più pulita. Qui, il progresso è un'aspettativa - per voi, la vostra squadra, e il mondo. Come leader di mercato globale, vi daremo quello che dovete fare per farlo accadere. Non sarà sempre facile, la crescita prende grinta. Ma ad ABB, non correrete mai da soli. Eseguire ciò che dirige il mondo. • Responsabilità In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di contribuire al successo di ABB con tecnologia, software, prodotto e sviluppo di sistema. Ogni giorno, si identifica e implementa soluzioni innovative per problemi rilevanti. Esaminare le proprie competenze, fornendo idee e realizzando programmi di collaborazione in modo indipendente e come parte di un gruppo di ricerca e sviluppo (R&D). • Qualifiche per il ruolo Sei altamente esperto in C/C++/Python/assembler supportato da solidi fondamenti informatici. Hai una solida conoscenza nei processi di sviluppo strutturati, che vanno dall'analisi dei requisiti, dalla progettazione e dall'implementazione alla prova e alla documentazione. Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella progettazione del firmware di controllo basato su microcontroller / DSP per prodotti elettronici di potenza come UPS, BESS, sistemi di energia rinnovabile. Possede una maggiore conoscenza dell'infrastruttura di sviluppo: Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, sistemi di controllo della versione (git), gestione del ciclo di vita, sistemi di costruzione, test di unità, sonde di debug, oscilloscopi e strumenti simili. Siete appassionati del lavoro di squadra e dell'innovazione. Sei a tuo agio a comunicare in inglese e italiano Smart Power fornisce soluzioni di distribuzione energetica per data center, impianti industriali e produttivi, infrastrutture critiche e edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della Divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, offrendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano obiettivi di crescita rapida, transizione energetica e sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS ad alta efficienza energetica. ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager offre una piattaforma scalabile e facile da usare che consente alle organizzazioni di risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2. Fai parte del team in cui il progresso accade, le industrie trasformano e il tuo lavoro plasma il mondo.
Run Che cosa corre il mondo. Apprezziamo le persone provenienti da diversi background. Potrebbe essere la tua storia? Applicare oggi o visitare www.abb.com per saperne di più su di noi e conoscere l'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir den Industrien zu entkommen - schlanker und sauberer. Hier ist Fortschritt eine Erwartung - für Sie, Ihr Team und die Welt. Als globaler Marktführer geben wir Ihnen, was Sie brauchen, um dies zu erreichen. Es wird nicht immer einfach sein, Wachstum braucht Körnung. Aber bei ABB wirst du nie alleine laufen. Führen Sie, was die Welt beherrscht.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Chapter Leader (Control Firmware)


Ihre Rolle und • Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Funktion haben Sie die Möglichkeit, zum Erfolg von ABB mit Technologie-, Software-, Produkt- und Systementwicklung beizutragen. Jeden Tag identifizieren und implementieren Sie innovative Lösungen für relevante Probleme. Sie werden auch Ihr Fachwissen präsentieren, indem Sie Ideen zur Verfügung stellen und in der Lage sind, sowohl unabhängig als auch als Teil eines Forschungs- und Entwicklungsteams zu arbeiten.

Arbeitsmodell: #LI-Hybrid

Firmware Development: Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Implementieren von Firmware für Power Electronic Converters und Kommunikationsmodule, um robuste Funktionalität und Cybersicherheit zu gewährleisten.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Systemarchitekten und Hardware/Softwareingenieuren zusammen, um Systemanforderungen in detaillierte Firmwarespezifikationen zu übersetzen.< • Qualifikationen für die Rolle

    • Sie sind hochqualifiziert in C/C++/Python/Assembler, unterstützt von soliden Grundlagen der Informatik.

    • Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in strukturierten Entwicklungsprozessen, die von Anforderungsanalyse, Design und Implementierung bis hin zu Test und Dokumentation reichen.

    • Sie haben mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Steuerungsfirmware auf Basis von Mikrocontrollern / DSPs für Leistungselektronikprodukte wie UPS, BESS, Erneuerbare Energiesysteme.

    • Verfügen Sie über ein erweitertes Wissen über Entwicklungsinfrastruktur: Azure DevOps, CI/CD-Pipelines, Versionskontrollsysteme (git), Lifecycle-Management, Build-Systeme, Unit-Tests, Debug-Sonden, Oszilloskope und ähnliche Tools.

    • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Ethernet/IP, IEC61850, Profibus, CAN bus) sind ein Plus.

      • Sie sind begeistert von Teamarbeit und Innovation.

    • M.Sc. oder B.Sc. Abschluss in Information oder Elektrik, Power Electronic, Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems oder vergleichbarem Bereich

      • Sie können problemlos auf Englisch und Italienisch kommunizieren

    Mehr über uns

    ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Produktionsanlagen, kritische Infrastrukturen und Geschäftsgebäude. Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitsgeräte wie Schalter und Relais. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Plattform, mit der Unternehmen Energie sparen und CO2-Emissionen reduzieren können.

    Steigen Sie sich uns an. Werden Sie Teil des Teams, in dem Fortschritt stattfindet, sich Industrien verändern und Ihre Arbeit die Welt prägt.
    Run What Runs the World.

    #ABBCareers #RunwithABB

    Wir schätzen Menschen mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund. Könnte das deine Geschichte sein? Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie www.abb.com, um mehr über uns zu lesen und mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous vous donnerons ce dont vous avez besoin pour que cela se produise. Il n'a pas toujours été facile, la croissance prend du grain. Mais à ABB, vous ne fuirez jamais seul. Exécutez ce qui exécute le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Chapitre Leader (Control Firmware)


Votre rôle et • Responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de contribuer au succès de l'ABB avec la technologie, les logiciels, les produits et le développement du système. Chaque jour, vous identifierez et appliquerez des solutions innovantes aux problèmes pertinents.

Modèle de travail : #LI-Hybrid

<=

    • Vous êtes hautement qualifié en C/C++/Python/assembleur soutenu par de solides fondamentaux en informatique.

    • Vous avez de solides connaissances dans les processus de développement structurés, allant de l'analyse des besoins, de la conception et de la mise en oeuvre aux tests et à la documentation.

    • Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la conception de firmware de contrôle basé sur des microcontrôleurs / DSP pour des produits électroniques de puissance tels que UPS, BESS, systèmes d'énergie renouvelable.

    • Posséder une meilleure connaissance de l'infrastructure de développement : Azure DevOps, pipelines CI/CD, systèmes de contrôle de version (git), gestion du cycle de vie, systèmes de construction, essais unitaires, sondes de débogage, oscilloscopes et outils similaires.

    • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Ethernet/IP, IEC61850, Profibus, CAN bus) is a plus.

    • Vous êtes passionné par le travail en équipe et l'innovation.

    • M.Sc. ou B.Sc. en information ou en génie électrique, électronique, électronique, systèmes embarqués ou domaine comparable

    • Vous êtes à l'aise de communiquer en anglais et en italien

    Plus sur nous

    ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures essentielles et les bâtiments commerciaux. Les équipes techniques de la Division travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de l'industrie, fournissant des solutions avancées qui soutiennent la croissance rapide, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité. Le portefeuille de la Division comprend des disjoncteurs industriels, des systèmes à basse tension, des applications de démarrage de moteurs et des dispositifs de sécurité comme les commutateurs et les relais. Son unité de protection de l'énergie prend en charge les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données du monde avec des solutions UPS à haut rendement énergétique. La division ABB CapacityTM Energy Manager fournit une plateforme évolutive et facile à utiliser qui aide les organisations à économiser de l'énergie et à réduire les émissions de CO2.

    Rejoignez-nous. Faites partie de l'équipe où le progrès se produit, les industries se transforment, et votre travail façonne le monde.
    Run What Run the World.

    #ABBCareers #RunwithABB

    Nous apprécions les gens de différents horizons. Ça pourrait être votre histoire ? Faites une demande aujourd'hui ou visitez www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et découvrez l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Test Engineer (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager


Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this position, you will provide assistance in testing and verification activities on a range of assignments in the UPS products of ABB Smart Power in Quartino. You will be in charge of the testing and verification activities for low- and medium-complexity systems, subsystems, or products.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defining the troubleshooting procedure and troubleshooting level two, in case a new event occurs not covered by the troubleshooting procedure.

  • Maintaining, changing, and optimizing test instructions for mass production in consultancy with the R&D Engineer (Center of Excellence).

  • Providing technical support during the installation of test objects in the test area.

  • Assisting the Production Supervisor in defining and maintaining the skill matrix for test operators.


• Qualifications for the role

  • At least 3 years of experience in UPS, working as a service technician, or in engineering, testing, etc.

  • Sound knowledge of engineering techniques, processes, and tools, including measurement with a power meter, oscilloscope, etc.

  • A strong focus on safe work practices and dedication to following workplace safety guidelines.

  • A high level of self-motivation, curiosity, and desire to learn about new technologies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach, and strong written and spoken communication skills.

  • A degree in electrical/electronic or similar field · Fluent in English


More about us


ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

#MyABBStory

Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous vous donnerons ce dont vous avez besoin pour que cela se produise. Il n'a pas toujours été facile, la croissance prend du grain. Mais à ABB, vous ne fuirez jamais seul. Exécutez ce qui fonctionne dans le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Production Engineering Manager


Votre rôle et vos responsabilités (mandataire)

Dans cette position, vous fournirez une assistance dans les activités de test et de vérification sur une gamme de missions dans les produits UPS d'ABB Smart Power en Quartino. Vous serez en charge des activités d'essai et de vérification des systèmes, sous-systèmes ou produits à faible et moyenne complexité.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est hybride. #LI-Hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Définition de la procédure de dépannage et du niveau de dépannage deux, au cas où un nouvel événement ne serait pas couvert par la procédure de dépannage.

  • Maintien, modification et optimisation des instructions d'essai pour la production de masse en consultant l'ingénieur en R-D (Centre d'excellence).

  • Fournir un soutien technique pendant l'installation d'objets d'essai dans la zone d'essai.

  • Assister le superviseur de la production pour définir et maintenir la matrice des compétences des opérateurs d'essai.


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Au moins 3 années d'expérience en UPS, en tant que technicien de services, en génie, en essais, etc.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

SST Product Architect

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Senior Power Electronics Testing and Laboratory Specialist to be part of the expansion of our business with a novel solid state transformer technology for datacenter applications. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of the ELDS R&D center of excellence team for Solid State Transformer in charge of the design and development of the future Solid State Transformer products family with first focus on Data Center application requirements. In this context, and as part of the R&D SST development team, the Senior Testing and Laboratory Specialist will have special focus on the implementation and execution of the validation, qualification and certification testing activities and protocols for components, sub-systems and systems within the internal and external R&D and Production Lab facilities for the new ABB SST offering. The location for this position is Baden-Daettwil in Switzerland, with relocation possibilities to other production locations.

You will be mainly responsible for:

  • Member of the SST for Data Center R&D team, leading the testing activities in R&D labs for the Validation, Qualification and Certification of the SST components, sub-systems and systems using the R&D Prototypes and Tests Units in the existing and new internal testing setups and areas and in external facilities. This includes planning, practical implementation and execution, analysis and documentation activities of SST tests, with close interaction with program manager, product architect, other R&D engineers, testing and laboratory specialists and technicians.

  • Responsible for the definition of the SST dedicated lab test processes and protocols, infrastructure, areas and equipment, with active interaction and collaboration with the different stakeholders in the different locations involved (CH, CZ, IT, US), including the Lab Infrastructure and the Health Safety and Environment (HSE) teams.

  • Close support and collaboration with the productization and factory teams for the SST production testing activities, involving the definition of the test specifications, the training of testing engineers, test data and results documentation, adaptation of tests protocols, etc.

  • Contribution to the maintenance and further development of the key Power Electronics Technologies Expertise and Know-How of the SST for Datacenters R&D team in testing, validation and certification.

You will be part of advanced R&D activities in the field of power electronics for the ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in close cooperation with a highly qualified senior team of R&D engineers and scientists in a global and multicultural setup.

• Qualifications for the role

  • University, University of Applied Sciences Bachelor or Master degree, or Equivalent Experience in the field of electrical engineering with focus on Power Electronics testing, validation, qualification and certification.

  • Solid background experience and high interest on practical R&D experimentation, testing and validation in Medium Voltage and High Power lab environment for the introduction to the market of Power Electronics converter new products and functionalities. Expertise in solutions and components validation, productization and certification in MV environment is desired.

  • Know-how and expertise in test systems, equipment and infrastructure related to the validation and qualification of power electronics components and sub-systems testing, including protocols for safety, quality, reliability, and certification.

  • Interest in applied research and development, self-organized, motivated person, that likes to work in a highly qualified research and development team composed of experts in different domains and global locations.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English. German is a plus.

  • Availability to travel sporadically.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
